info.title: Firework API
info.description:
Manage and access Firework resources.

Requests are authenticated with API tokens, which are obtained using an API key:

1. Generate an API key from the [Profile page](https://app.flare.io/#/profile).
2. Send a `POST` request to `https://api.flare.io/tokens/generate` with the `Authorization: <api-key>` header to get an API token. API tokens expire after 1 hour.
3. Call the API endpoints with the `Authorization: Bearer <api-token>` header.

See [Authentication](https://api.docs.flare.io/concepts/authentication) for details.
